$comment: Florida ingest scope. VERIFIED 2026-08 by scripts/probe-fl.mjs. The Senate publishes the ENTIRE constitution as one 622KB document at /Laws/Constitution, navigated by fragment anchors (#A11S05 is Article XI Section 5). So the fetched unit is the whole constitution and the cited unit is a section — the widest gap between the two of any state so far, and the reason source_url and citation_url are separate fields. Note the ref is Art. XI Sec. 5, not 5(e): subsection (e) carries the sixty-percent threshold, but the section is the citable unit and the gloss says which part matters. Same call as Texas Art. VII Sec. 3.

targets.expect: sixty percent of the electors voting on the measure
